milestone.title: Optional link engine: native default, GNU stow opt-in

intent.outcome: Default install runs without GNU stow: native engine creates/removes package symlinks (stow/unstow/restow, dry-run, ignores). Users may set global.engine: stow for the classic backend. doctor only requires stow when that engine is selected.

problem.description: Bulk apply shells out to stow, forcing GNU stow on every host. Status/single unstow are already native. Need native-by-default LinkEngine with stow opt-in. This is a behavior default change: document for users who rely on folding. Execute wiring must land after M05 App-owned runtime to avoid double-rewrites of Confirm/Execute.

in_scope: Config: global.engine native|stow (default native). Flags under global.stow.* apply where engine supports them.
LinkEngine trait in andre-core (plan + apply): stow, unstow, restow; dry_run; ignores; structured results.
NativeEngine v1: no_folding-first file-level symlinks; dry_run plans without writes; ignores honored.
Unsupported native flags (folding/adopt/dotfiles when they would change behavior): explicit error recommending engine: stow — not silent wrong links.
StowEngine wraps existing build_stow_args/execute_stow; clear error if stow missing.
Wire Confirm/yolo/execute through engine selection after M05 App ownership lands.
doctor/deps: stow required only when engine is stow.
Automated tests for native stow/unstow/restow/dry_run that do not invoke the stow binary (unit/integration in andre-core preferred).
CHANGELOG: breaking note that default engine is native (folding users should set engine: stow); demo config example.
Config-only for engine in S1; Settings TUI picker is optional stretch, not required for AC-05.
out_of_scope: Full GNU stow parity (folding, adopt matrices, --dotfiles renames) in v1.

design_decisions.choice: native is default; stow is opt-in via config
design_decisions.rationale: Matches product goal: no hard dependency on external stow for the common path.

design_decisions.choice: andre-core LinkEngine trait used by execute/yolo; TUI stays engine-agnostic
design_decisions.rationale: Deep module: one place for link semantics; UI only shows progress/results.

design_decisions.choice: Ship native with no_folding-first semantics and explicit unsupported/partial flags for adopt/folding/dotfiles; stow engine remains escape hatch
design_decisions.rationale: Avoid false full-parity claims; keep users unblocked.

design_decisions.choice: global.engine: native | stow (default native). Stow-specific flags stay under global.stow.*
design_decisions.rationale: Short, discoverable; avoids burying engine under stow.* which implies GNU-only.

design_decisions.choice: no_folding-first file-level symlinks only; folding/adopt/dotfiles unsupported or explicit error pointing at engine: stow
design_decisions.rationale: Correct simple model first; stow remains escape hatch for advanced flags.

design_decisions.choice: No hard depends_on M05/M06; prefer after M05 if Execute ownership changes land first, but core LinkEngine can land independently
design_decisions.rationale: Engine is andre-core; TUI wire is thin.

design_decisions.choice: depends_on M05 and M06. Execute only after both complete.
design_decisions.rationale: Needs App-owned execute runtime (M05) and stable config/error stack (M06) before LinkEngine + default flip.

design_decisions.choice: effort L, risk medium-high (symlink correctness, default behavior change)

findings.description: ui::render_confirm builds a 'stow ...' command preview per package regardless of engine. Under the native default this misleads users into thinking GNU stow will run (it will not). render_confirm already receives &Config, so make the preview engine-aware (show a native preview when config.effective_engine()==native).

The legacy Adopt flow (andre_core::adopt::execute_adoption) and ui::render_confirm still call build_stow_args directly, bypassing the LinkEngine seam (S2 goal: no Command::new(stow) outside StowEngine). Adopt is stow-only by design (NativeEngine rejects adopt=true); accepted residual — gate/route the Adopt UI through the engine in a follow-up.

Native engine v1 --ignore matches each ignore as a literal substring of the relative path, NOT the regex stow uses (e.g. '.*\.log' will not match debug.log). Documented in engine.rs + AGENTS notes; recommend engine: stow for regex ignores. Accepted v1 limitation.

AsyncExecutor wraps engine.apply in tokio::task::spawn_blocking with a 60s timeout; on timeout the blocking thread (and any spawned stow child) cannot be cancelled and lingers until it finishes. Minor regression from the prior async-process cancel. Native (default) fs ops do not hang; affects only engine: stow.

NativeEngine unstow/restow/stow treat any symlink at the target path as removable: apply RemoveSymlink deletes any is_symlink path, and CreateSymlink removes any existing symlink before recreate. Stow only touches links that resolve into the package. Reproducing: stow pkg A (.bashrc), then unstow pkg B that also lists .bashrc removes A's link. Fix: only remove/replace symlinks whose resolved target is under the package source (same ownership check as check_stowed_status); foreign symlinks and real files must conflict on create and be no-ops on unstow. Add a regression test.
findings.author: external-agent

findings.description: check_dependencies.sh still has a RUN_MET=false recommendation block telling users to install GNU Stow, but stow is no longer a hard runtime dep and nothing sets RUN_MET=false for missing stow. Dead/misleading residual from the optional-engine change. Update the recommendation text to match AC-03 (stow optional; only needed for global.engine: stow) or remove the stow-specific install guidance from the hard-fail path.

findings.description: ui::render_confirm stow-engine preview still passes &[] ignores into build_stow_args, so the Review Commands screen omits --ignore flags the real StowEngine apply will use (via config.effective_ignores). Misleading preview under engine: stow. Pass config.effective_ignores(group_name).
